research_problem_model.research_title_fa: بررسی ارزش پیش‌آگهی تیتر آنتی‌بادی ضد گیرنده فسفولیپاز A2 (anti-PLA2R) بر پسرفت پروتئینوری و بقای کلیوی در نفروپاتی غشایی ایدیوپاتیک
research_problem_model.research_title_en: Prognostic Value of Serial Anti-Phospholipase A2 Receptor (anti-PLA2R) Autoantibody Titers on Clinical Remission and Renal Survival in Idiopathic Membranous Nephropathy

population_or_model.primary_system: Adult biopsy-proven primary membranous nephropathy patients with nephrotic range proteinuria

primary_outcomes.name: Complete Remission of Proteinuria (< 0.3 g/24h)
primary_outcomes.measurement_unit: Time in months to complete remission

primary_outcomes.name: Doubling of Serum Creatinine or End-Stage Kidney Disease
preferred_assays: Estimated GFR and clinical registry follow-up

hypothesized_mechanisms.pathway_name: Podocyte Immune Complex Deposition and Complement C5b-9 Lysis

studies.title: Anti-PLA2R antibody level predicts long-term renal outcome and treatment response in adult membranous nephropathy
studies.journal: Journal of the American Society of Nephrology

design_specific_attributes.target_population_criteria: 218 patients with biopsy-confirmed membranous nephropathy followed prospectively for 5 years
endpoint_assays: ELISA titer quantification and serum creatinine

studies.title: Discordance between immunological clearance and clinical proteinuria remission in advanced glomerulosclerosis

design_specific_attributes.target_population_criteria: Patients with chronicity index > 50% on baseline renal biopsy

negative_or_null_findings.description: Anti-PLA2R serological negativation preceded proteinuria reduction by median 8.4 months, causing false premature treatment termination in acute phases.
